citations.assessment: The Bavli names Rabbi Elazar ben Antigonus in a distinct transmission. Compare the separate Heilprin entry 536.
The Bavli names Rabbi Chanina ben Antigonus in a baraita. Compare Heilprin 1454; do not infer that both patronyms denote one historical father.
